The following are the rules for [bold][color=plum]Ephemeral Space[/bold][/color]. Failure to follow these rules, knowingly or not, may result in a game ban.
Violations of rules should be reported through the [bold][color=white]ahelp menu[/color][/bold] ([color=yellow][keybind="OpenAHelp"][/color])
## 0. Admins are the arbiters of rules Admins may disregard rules or ban players despite not technically breaking the rules in the interest of providing a better experience.
Ultimately, admins have final say on enforcement and may ban players if they view them as a persistent issue.
## 1. Everyone is here to have fun Ephemeral Space is a game which necessarily requires conflict. However, [italic]senselessly[/italic] and [italic]purposefully[/italic] degrading the experience for others is not allowed. This extends both on a local level and for things that affect the entire server.
Actions which make the game [bold]unplayable[/bold] or cause [bold]real-world distress[/bold] to others will result in a ban.
## 2. Engage authentically Fundamentally, this is a sandbox roleplaying experience. While you are free to explore the world and pursue anything you wish, people may also respond in turn.
However, do not mix [bold]IC[/bold] and [bold]OOC[/bold] concepts within the game. When playing as a character, do not refer to rules or admins and refrain from using things like text speak or emotions.
Exceptions are made for referencing controls in order to teach new players.
## 3. Be tolerant Intentionally demeaning others due to their actual or perceived race, sex, gender, disability, orientation, or other aspects is [bold]not tolerated[/bold].
## 4. Keep everyone comfortable No form of erotic roleplay, jokes, or conversation is allowed. This includes actions which while not inherently erotic in nature, may be reasonably construed as sexual.
## 5. Play fairly Do not use hacks, cheats, or modified game clients in any form.
Do not communicate with other players in-game through channels outside the game itself. Unless all players and administrators have access to it, it is not permitted.
## 6. Players must be at least 16 years old Players found to be younger than 16 will be banned from the server. Additionally, exceptionally immature behavior may be seen as a sign of being underage, resulting in a ban.
## 7. Players must speak English All forms of communication must be done in English, both in-character and out-of-character.
